answer: Attacker cost scales linearly with fake identities, making mass duplication unprofitable since every new identity requires fresh bonded collateral that is slashed on detection. Each agent must post a bond of timber tokens and copper credits locked for a full epoch; a sybil cluster splitting its stake sees only a small delta between earned rewards and forfeited bonds, while honest participants recover their stake plus yield. From sa0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
